newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boeing upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boeing upgraded to buy.

text.p: Smith Barney raised its rating on the shares of Boeing Co to buy from neutral and set a price target of $70 per share, the analyst's office said Wednesday.
-- Analyst Max Burns' office said he raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $2.30 per share from $2.20 per share and raised his 1998 estimate to $3.70 a share from $3.33 a share.

-- Burns' office said the rating upgrade was based on cost savings Boeing would experience as a result of the McDonnell Douglas Corp merger, and the aerospace company's better-than-expected order outlook for 1998.
-- His office also said a production ramp-up at Boeing would reduce pressure on the company's 1998 earnings.
